title: DocuMind
summary: RAG chatbot that answers questions from 10k+ internal documents with citations.
description: DocuMind indexes PDFs, Notion pages and support tickets into a vector store and answers employee questions with linked sources.
I designed the chunking and hybrid retrieval pipeline, built the streaming chat UI, and set up an eval suite that runs on every prompt change.

title: Shiplog
summary: Changelog and feedback board for SaaS teams, with email digests.
description: A fullstack app where product teams publish release notes and collect upvoted feature requests.
Built with React, Node.js and PostgreSQL; handles multi-tenant auth and billing.

title: Pairbot
summary: GitHub app that reviews pull requests and suggests focused fixes.
description: Pairbot reads the diff, related files and CI logs, then leaves inline review comments.
Tuned prompts with an offline eval set of 300 real review threads.

title: Flowline
summary: Automation pipeline that turns invoices into clean spreadsheet rows.
description: Combines OCR with an LLM extraction step and human review for low-confidence fields.
Processes around 2,000 documents a month for a logistics client.

title: edge-rate-limit
summary: Open source rate limiting toolkit for edge runtimes.
description: A tiny TypeScript library with sliding-window and token-bucket strategies.
Used in a handful of production Workers; 400+ stars on GitHub.

title: Kopi Counter
summary: Telegram bot that tracks how much coffee my team drinks. For science.
description: Log a cup with one tap; a weekly leaderboard crowns the most caffeinated developer.
A weekend project that ended up being used by three offices.
